title: Prominent Homepage Portfolio Showcase
description: Sarah, as an event manager, prioritizes seeing visual examples of past work, especially for corporate events, before engaging further. Placing a curated portfolio directly on the homepage will immediately address this key decision factor and build trust faster.
spec: Add a new section on the homepage, ideally below the 'What we offer' section, titled 'Our Featured Work' or 'Client Success Stories'. This section should display a carousel or grid of 3-4 high-impact video thumbnails or images from diverse corporate events (e.g., conferences, product launches, galas). Each item should have a concise title and a 'View Case Study' or 'Watch Video' call-to-action linking to a dedicated case study page or the full video.
